szene: In a small kitchen during the day, Resi sits at the kitchen table in front of a laptop with a mug of coffee, chin in her hand, reading the screen with a skeptical deadpan expression. Herbert sits on the rim of the mug and looks at the screen too.

In a shared flat kitchen with a sink full of stacked dirty dishes and pizza boxes on the counter, Resi stands in the middle holding a full black trash bag in one hand, deadpan, looking straight at the viewer. Herbert hangs upside down from the kitchen cabinet next to her.

In her living room, Resi stands upright and proudly holds a brand new upright vacuum cleaner next to her like a trophy, with a tiny satisfied smile on her otherwise deadpan face, the open cardboard box on the floor. Herbert sits on top of the vacuum cleaner handle.
